description: Upload a file from THIS machine to a work item, initiative or program and attach it: starts a direct upload, sends the bytes straight to Storage and completes it, for files up to 1 GB. Local (stdio) server only; the hosted connection refuses it with `local_files_unavailable`, use anyforge_start_file_upload there. Confirm the exact file with the user before sending it: the file leaves this machine. A file with the same name and size already on the record is not sent again ({ alreadyAttached: true, file }).

id.description: The work item, initiative or program id.

mediaType.description: Optional MIME type; the extension wins when they disagree.

name.description: Name to store it under. Defaults to the file name in `path`.

onNameConflict.description: A same-name file of a different size already on the record: refuse it (default, file_name_exists) or attach both. A same-name, same-size file is never attached twice.

originalCreatedAt.description: Optional. When the file was created in the tool it came from: an ISO 8601 date or a date and time with a zone, e.g. 2024-03-01T10:22:33.000+0000. Kept beside the upload time.

path.description: Absolute path of the file on this machine.

target.description: The kind of record the file is attached to.

name: anyforge_upload_local_file
title: Upload local file
